title: A powerops flow test file (*.flowtest.json)
description: One offline test of a Power Automate cloud flow, run by 'powerops test'. It names a flow, gives the run its trigger, mocks for the connector actions and fixed values, and lists assertions about the run. Closed on purpose: powerops rejects a property that is not listed here, and a wrong type or a missing required property, with exit code 3.

$schema.description: This schema's URL or path, for editors. Ignored by powerops.

flow.description: The cloud flow to run: its display name (exact match), or its workflow id (a GUID; braces and case are ignored). It must match exactly one cloud flow in the solutions under the path.

trigger.description: What triggerOutputs() returns in the run; triggerBody() returns its 'body'. Without it, a flow that reads the trigger is 'unmocked'.

headers.description: The trigger's headers, for example a manual trigger's 'X-MS-APIM-Tokens'.

body.description: The trigger's body: any JSON value, such as the Dataverse row a trigger returns.

mocks.description: Connector actions that do not run. The key is the action name. The value is one mock, or a list of mocks, one per call in order (for an action inside a Foreach or Until). Only OpenApiConnection, OpenApiConnectionWebhook, Http and Workflow actions, and actions with a static result enabled, take a mock; a connector action without one makes the test 'unmocked'.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variable schema name -> the JSON value for this run. It wins over the solution's current value and default value. The value is used as given: powerops does not convert it.

utcNow.description: The text every utcNow() call returns, for example '2026-01-02T03:04:05.0000000Z'. Without it, a flow that calls utcNow() is 'unmocked'.

guid.description: The text every guid() call returns. Without it, a flow that calls guid() is 'unmocked'. Every function argument is evaluated, so a guid() inside an if() needs it too.

workflow.description: The object workflow() returns. Without it, a flow that calls workflow() is 'unmocked'.

assertions.description: What must hold after the run. All of them are checked, in order, when the run finishes. Each has a 'kind' and an 'equals' value; the other properties depend on the kind.

mock.description: A connector action's result, in the shape of a static result.

status.description: The action's status. A simulated run never times out, so TimedOut is not available.

outputs.description: The action's outputs, as the run history's 'Show raw outputs' shows them: usually 'statusCode', 'headers' and 'body'. Pasted in unchanged.

error.description: The action's error. Only with status 'Failed'.

call.description: Which call of the action to check, counting from 0. An action inside a Foreach or Until is called once per iteration. Without it the assertion must hold on every call, and an action that did not run fails it.

path.description: Where to look inside the value: strings are properties, integers are array items from 0. A key with a slash such as 'item/pops_name' is one string, with no escaping. Without it, or empty, the whole value is compared.

equals.description: The expected status. Skipped means a trigger condition was false.

action.description: The action's name in the flow.

equals.description: The expected status. TimedOut never occurs in a simulated run.

inputsOrOutputs.description: What an action got (its inputs with every expression evaluated, which is what the flow would send) or returned.

kind.description: 'inputs' checks the evaluated inputs of the action; 'outputs' checks what it returned (for a mocked action, the mock's outputs).

action.description: The action's name in the flow.

equals.description: The expected value: any JSON value, null included. Compared as JSON, numbers by value.

variable.description: A variable's value at the end of the run.

kind.description: Checks a variable's value at the end of the run.

equals.description: The expected value: any JSON value, null included. Compared as JSON, numbers by value.

response.description: The first Response action that ran, as { statusCode, headers, body }.

kind.description: Checks the first Response action that ran. Fails when none ran.

equals.description: The expected value: any JSON value, null included. Compared as JSON, numbers by value.
